t: Low odour and styrene-free. Versatile, long-life product provides fast working times for early loading in time-sensitive applications. Chub seal system allows attachment of the application nozzle with no cutting required. For use in multiple applications such as securing gates, canopies, railings, hand rails, tracks and fence posts onto brick, blocks, hollow block and concrete base material. Can be used in wet environments such as in water-filled holes. Provides crack and gap-repairing technology in concrete and brick installations. Suitable for use with a standard silicon applicator gun such as a DFC1610000 (300ml Manual Adhesive Dispensing Tool) or DCE581N (18V Cordless Caulking Gun 300-600ml), both sold separately.
b: Can be Used Indoors & in Enclosed Spaces
Can be Reused by Fitting New Nozzle
General Purpose Use in Solid & Hollow Substrates
Can be Used in Water-Filled Holes (Not Sea Water)
